commands.assertions: Bridge attached-device persistence and handler/module registration pass with the trust-state Get operation.
A revoked attached device is rejected at lease input validation before transport actuation, while unrelated local session behavior remains independent.
Attached trust-state Get and existing callbacks are represented in the generated endpoint manifest.

assertions: Bridge GetAttachedDevice returns revoked records instead of hiding their trust state behind the active-only inventory list.
Device Control rechecks Bridge-owned trust immediately before input and refuses revoked or unreachable attached peripherals.
The refusal occurs before strategy actuation and creates no actuation audit receipt for the revoked device.
limitations: The focused fixture proves the owner boundary and lease fence; a live remote phone revocation over a running channel remains unverified.
